reason: Section 85.6 'Life cycle Inventory for titanium dioxide' says the industry input information may not be divulged, but it then prints the BAT-Notes figures the inventory was built on, split by process route. For the CHLORIDE process these are Tab. 85.3 (synthetic rutile 1.06 kg/kg, chlorine 0.18 kg/kg), Tab. 85.5 (electricity, steam, gas in MJ/kg), Tab. 85.7 (direct air emissions) and Tab. 85.9 (wastewater emissions). Pages 845-847 cover all four plus the introducing paragraphs.
